notes.title: Korean Version of Last Cloudia Released!
notes.notes:
■
[TOKYO, JAPAN – Nov 15, 2022] AIDIS Inc. announced that a Korean-language version of its popular mobile RPG Last Cloudia is now available to play from today on both Android and iOS devices. The Korean version is published by Boltrend Games, a company based in Hong Kong. Boltrend Games also handles Last Cloudia’s Traditional Chinese localization.

In celebration, Japanese and English version players will receive a special present of 500 crystals. To receive this reward, players of those versions should log in to Last Cloudia between Nov 17, post-maintenance and Dec 14, 6:59 am (PT).

Following Last Cloudia’s initial Japanese release in April 2019, English and Traditional Chinese versions released later have brought the game to players worldwide. With this release of a Korean version, Last Cloudia can now be played in 34 different countries.

AIDIS Inc. will continue to work hard and bring Last Cloudia to even more players around the globe to enjoy.

Official Korean version website: https://lastcloudia.boltrend.com/kr
Official Korean version community: https://game.naver.com/lounge/Last_Cloudia/home

Thank you for your continued support of Last Cloudia.
The Last Cloudia Management Team

© 2018-2022 AIDIS Inc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/2d835e341b686e1a12cb0763242da6c7a752cbc2.jpg[/img][TOKYO, JAPAN – Sep 26, 2022] AIDIS Inc. announced that a Korean-language version of its popular mobile RPG Last Cloudia will be released at a later date. The Korean version will be published by Boltrend Games, a company based in Hong Kong. Boltrend Games also handles Last Cloudia’s Simplified Chinese localization.

Beta testing for the Korean version is now open to the public. Players interested in helping with beta testing should check the official website and community page linked below for more information on how to participate.

AIDIS Inc. will continue to work hard and bring Last Cloudia to even more players around the globe to enjoy.

Official Korean version website: https://lastcloudia.boltrend.com/kr
Official Korean version community: https://game.naver.com/lounge/Last_Cloudia/home


About Boltrend Games
Based in Hong Kong, Chinese game company Boltrend Games is devoted to creating and publishing games for regions the world over, including Japan, Korea, Southeast Asia, the U.S., Europe, Hong Kong, Taiwan, and Macau. They offer the best service to game developers worldwide, and the best experience to game players of all kinds. Utilizing the latest in cross-platform technology, they aim to make their games entertaining and playable on multiple platforms.

Official website: https://www.devilmaycry5.com/us/

 

Thank you for your continued support of Last Cloudia.

notes.title: Original Soundtrack Release Date Confirmed! Promo Event Starts Today!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/3c0f357ae6d021c7215d0e706abaadf22dd4c02e.jpg[/img]
Last Cloudia’s original soundtracks hit store shelves on October 15, 2022!

Vol. 1 of the soundtrack contains a total of 40 tracks, including fan-favorite songs such as Destiny and Last Cloudia. Vol. 2 contains 38 tracks, and features beloved tunes such as Path of Light and New Sky. As a bonus feature, all first pressing albums will come with a sticker of the jacket artwork.

Preorders start today. Add these Last Cloudia soundtracks to your collection and relive the adventure!

Place your preorder here:
https://bit.ly/3Q6cJPG

*We also plan to release the original soundtracks via digital distribution. More information will be available in the future.
